title: QualityReport
description: Returned by dispatch() alongside the LLM output. MUST always be provided.

session_id.description: UUID v4 identifying the session. MUST be stable across all windows in a session.

window_id.description: UUID v4 identifying this specific window invocation.

output.description: The complete, unmodified LLM output (Axiom 9 — Output Integrity). MUST NOT be filtered, summarized, or truncated by CRP.

facts_extracted.description: Number of facts extracted from this window's output.

continuation_windows.description: Number of continuation windows triggered (0 if output fit in one window).

envelope_saturation.description: Fraction of available envelope space used (0.0–1.0). SHOULD be > 0.9 for non-trivial tasks.

quality_tier.description: CRP quality tier for this task based on window count (§10).

security_flags.description: Security observations for this window. MUST always be present.

telemetry.description: Performance telemetry. MAY be omitted if telemetry is disabled.

injection_markers_detected.description: Count of injection pattern matches detected in input.

pattern_name.description: Name of the matched injection pattern.

matched_text.description: The text that matched the pattern.

injection_marker_details.description: Details of each injection pattern match.

unicode_normalized.description: Whether Unicode normalization was applied to input.

control_chars_stripped.description: Count of control characters removed from input.

input_truncated.description: Whether input was truncated to fit max_task_input_bytes.

integrity_violations.description: Count of fact integrity chain verification failures.
